@deskSetSearchHint.description: Settings search field: placeholder and its name for screen readers.

@deskSetSearchKeyHint.description: Settings search field: the keyboard shortcut shown at its right end. Keep the key names as on the keyboard.

@deskSetSearchClear.description: Settings search: the button that empties the search field.

@deskSetSearchCount.description: Settings search: heading over the results; counts every result listed (settings, Help topics, hidden ones). Read out by screen readers.

@deskSetSearchFor.description: Settings search: beside the result count, what was searched. Use the language's own quotation marks.

@deskSetSearchKeysMove.description: Settings search: key hint after the up and down arrow keys.

@deskSetSearchKeysGo.description: Settings search: key hint after the Enter key.

@deskSetSearchKeysClear.description: Settings search: key hint after the Esc key.

@deskSetSearchMatches.description: Settings search result: the result was found through this other word (a synonym), not its name. Use the language's own quotation marks.

@deskSetSearchHelpTopics.description: Settings search: heading of the Help topics that match.

@deskSetSearchHidden.description: Settings search: heading of matching settings that the current view or an Advanced switch hides.

deskSetSearchHiddenLine: Another view or an Advanced switch shows them

@deskSetSearchHiddenLine.description: Settings search: line beside the Hidden here heading.

@deskSetSearchShowIn.description: Settings search, hidden result: button that changes to the view that shows the setting, then goes to it. view is Shallow, Deeper or Deep end.

@deskSetSearchTurnOn.description: Settings search, hidden result: button that turns on the Advanced switch that shows the setting, then goes to it.

@deskSetSearchOpen.description: Settings search result: button that goes to the setting on its page.

@deskSetSearchRead.description: Settings search, Help topic result: button that opens the topic in Help.

@deskSetSearchNone.description: Settings search: nothing matches. Use the language's own quotation marks.

@deskSetSearchTry.description: Settings search, nothing found: before a few example words to search for.

@deskSetSearchTryWords.description: Settings search, nothing found: example words to search for, comma-separated, lower case, in this language (each must find a setting).

@deskSetSearchNoResults.description: Settings navigation while searching: read by screen readers for a section without matching settings.

@deskSetSearchResults.description: Settings search: the results list's name for screen readers.

@deskSetSearchViewGate.description: What shows a hidden setting: a view. view is Shallow, Deeper or Deep end, e.g. "Deep end view".

@deskSetSearchFeatGate.description: What shows a hidden setting: a switch on Settings › Advanced, e.g. "Advanced › Invoices".

@deskSetSearchGateJoin.description: Joins the reasons that show hidden options: "Deep end view and Advanced › Invoices". first may itself be a comma-separated list.

deskSetSearchMore: {count, plural, =1{1 more option · shown with {gates}} other{{count} more options · shown with {gates}}}

@deskSetSearchMore.description: More options control (⇕): its tooltip and name while folded. gates names what shows them, e.g. "Deep end view and Advanced › Invoices".

deskSetSearchLess: {count, plural, =1{Hide the extra option} other{Hide the {count} extra options}}

@deskSetSearchLess.description: More options control (⇕): its tooltip and name while the hidden options show.

@deskSetSearchViewApplied.description: Notice after a search result changed the view. view is Shallow, Deeper or Deep end.

@deskSetSearchFeatApplied.description: Notice after a search result turned on an Advanced switch.

@deskSetSearchFallbackView.description: Notice when a link opens a Settings page the current view hides; the first page of its group opens instead. view is Shallow, Deeper or Deep end.

@deskSetSearchFallbackFeat.description: Notice when a link opens a Settings page an Advanced switch hides; the first page of its group opens instead.

@deskSetSecWallet.description: Settings navigation: the open wallet's page (name, backup, balance, remove).

@deskSetSecPayments.description: Settings navigation: payment methods, sending and receiving.

@deskSetSecDevices.description: Settings navigation: this wallet on other devices.

@deskSetSecWallets.description: Settings navigation: the wallets on this computer.

@deskSetSecFiles.description: Settings navigation: folders and logs on this computer.

@deskSetNavApp.description: Settings navigation: heading of the app-wide sections.

@deskSetNavComputer.description: Settings navigation: heading of the sections about this computer.
